Build a graph from an edge list

Source: R/graph-conversion.R
graph_from_edgelist.Rd

Accepts edges that refer to external node identifiers (character or numeric, not necessarily consecutive) and maps them to one based node indices. Node order follows nodes[[id_col]] when a node table is given, and otherwise the order of first appearance in from then to.

Usage

graph_from_edgelist(
  edges,
  from = "from",
  to = "to",
  nodes = NULL,
  id_col = "id",
  feature_cols = NULL,
  label_col = NULL,
  edge_feature_cols = NULL,
  weight_col = NULL,
  edge_label_col = NULL,
  directed = TRUE
)

edgelist_from_graph(g)

Arguments

edges

Data frame with one row per edge.

from, to

Column names in edges holding source and target identifiers.

nodes

Optional data frame with one row per node, including nodes without edges.

id_col

Identifier column in nodes.

feature_cols

Numeric columns of nodes used as node features.

label_col

Column of nodes used as node labels.

edge_feature_cols

Numeric columns of edges used as edge features.

weight_col

Column of edges holding edge weights.

edge_label_col

Column of edges holding edge labels.

directed

Whether edges are directed.

g

A graph_data object.

Value

A graph_data object.

Examples

edges <- data.frame(from = c("a", "b", "c"), to = c("b", "c", "a"),
                    w = c(0.5, 1, 2))
g <- graph_from_edgelist(edges, weight_col = "w")
g$node_ids
#> [1] "a" "b" "c"
edgelist_from_graph(g)
#>   from to weight
#> 1    a  b    0.5
#> 2    b  c    1.0
#> 3    c  a    2.0
